title: Turkish Eggs (Cilbir)
subtitle: poached eggs on garlicky yoghurt with chilli butter
excerpt: Cilbir is a Turkish dish of poached eggs on cool, garlicky yoghurt, finished with a hot drizzle of butter spiked with chilli. The contrast between the cold yoghurt and the warm egg and butter is the whole point. It takes about 15 minutes and looks striking on the plate.
sourceNotes: Cilbir has been eaten in Turkey since at least the 15th century, during the Ottoman period. It is a simple dish of poached eggs, yoghurt, and spiced butter that has remained largely unchanged.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Mix the yoghurt ahead and keep chilled. Cook eggs and butter just before serving.

content.text: The yoghurt should be at room temperature -- straight from the fridge will chill the eggs too fast. Make the chilli butter last, just before serving.
Mix the yoghurt with the grated garlic and a pinch of salt. Spread across two plates or shallow bowls.
Bring a pan of water to a gentle simmer. Add the vinegar. Poach the eggs for 3 minutes until the whites are just set. Lift out with a slotted spoon and drain briefly.
Place two eggs on each plate of yoghurt.
Melt the butter in a small pan over medium heat until it foams and starts to smell nutty. Add the chilli flakes and stir for 30 seconds.
Pour the hot chilli butter over the eggs. Scatter with dill and serve immediately with flatbread or toast.

items.symptom: Butter turned black instead of brown
items.fix: Keep the heat medium and watch closely. Once nutty-smelling, remove from heat immediately.

items.symptom: Eggs sank and spread across the pan
items.cause: Old eggs or water boiling too hard
items.fix: Use fresh eggs and keep the water at a bare simmer.

content.text: Cilbir appears in Ottoman culinary texts from the 15th century, making it one of the oldest documented egg dishes in the region. It remained a home-cooked staple in Turkey while gaining international attention in the 2010s. The combination of cool dairy and hot spiced butter is found in other Turkish and Middle Eastern dishes -- this is one of its clearest expressions.
